cases.title: Approval Boundary

input.request: Attempt a high-impact task with no scoped approval.

cases.expected_output: Task remains blocked until a non-expired approval references its task ID and scope.
success_criteria: Required outcome: Task remains blocked until a non-expired approval references its task ID and scope.
